test.description: Run the same work lifecycle through the actual CLI and MCP executables and compare the resulting state. Also attack invalid requests and retry handling.

source.name: Representative lifecycle assertions; the saved command also runs operation and receipt regressions.

test.inputs: Disposable Git repositories with the same spec and behavior. Submit equivalent permission, begin-work, progress, check, review, close and complete requests through CLI and MCP. Negative cases use denied permissions, stale digests, reused request IDs and missing evidence.
test.expected: Both executables reach the same verified completion state. Equivalent invalid requests return the same error and leave domain state unchanged. An uncertain or duplicate request must not repeat its effect.
